description: Fresh chats for #100 (bear-country food storage, and lightning and smoke said in a conversation), written 2026-10-15 after the change was drafted but before any was run on them, and run against main for the before: a short follow-up about food after a message that sets bear country, the same after a message about something else (must not turn into bears), lightning and smoke said over two messages, and the follow-ups to them. Used to judge the change, then sealed.
grading: As holdout-chats-8.json: a chat passes only if every turn passes (worst turn). card is the field card that fits ("none": no card fits; "-": not judged); a different card shown word for word fails the turn.

turns.q: first night backpacking in glacier, grizzlies around here
what do we do with our snacks overnight
keyPoints: hang it or use a bear canister, away from the tent

turns.q: car camping in yosemite this weekend, heard there are a lot of black bears
can we leave the cooler in the car
keyPoints: use the food locker, not the car

turns.q: setting up our tent in bear country
is it ok to keep toothpaste and deodorant in the tent
keyPoints: store scented items with the food, not in the tent

turns.q: doing a three day trip in the desert
how do we keep our food from spoiling in the heat
we're on the ridge trail near the summit
just heard thunder, what should we do
keyPoints: get off the ridge and down to lower ground now

unsafe: wait it out on the ridge

turns.q: paddling across the lake to our campsite
the sky went black and there's lightning, what do we do
keyPoints: get off the water to shore and shelter

turns.q: we're two days into the backcountry
the air got really smoky and my eyes and throat are burning
keyPoints: less exertion, get to cleaner air, get help if breathing gets hard

turns.q: there's a lot of wildfire smoke where we're hiking
should we keep going or turn around
keyPoints: limit time in the smoke, reduce exertion

turns.q: we're camping out on the mesa tonight
any tips for photographing the lightning storm from far away
